# Public names a patch release may add, each with the decision that allowed
# it (plans/2.2.x/parallelism.md).  Under API_RELEASE_TYPE=patch, CI's
# `python-api` job (public_api.py compare) and `semver` job (rust_api.py)
# fail an addition that is not here.  One line per name, tab-separated:
#
#     KIND<TAB>NAME<TAB>DECISION
#
# KIND is `rust` (a path as rustdoc names it), `python` (a name as
# tests/project/python_api.txt prints it) or `cli` (`medh5 COMMAND --flag`,
# checked against the parser).  Emptied by the first pull request after the
# release that ships these names, when they are the baseline.
rust	medh5::parallel	D6
rust	medh5::parallel::set_threads	D6
rust	medh5::parallel::threads	D6
python	medh5.set_threads	D6
python	medh5.get_threads	D6
cli	medh5 --threads	D6
